primaryWitnesses.text: So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria, and he carried away the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, and brought them to Halah, Habor, Hara, and to the river of Gozan, to this day.
primaryWitnesses.previousContext: They trespassed against the God of their fathers, and played the prostitute after the gods of the peoples of the land whom God destroyed before them.
